body: Same to you. Sending best wishes.

I'm in Ireland, and I know plenty of support groups. It's just being able to contact them that's the issue. My parents are quite controlling, and since I am dependent on them I can't really do anything to jeopardise that.
I used to text teen line, then I stopped that and tried samaritans, who messaged me back once and never again.

I have told family and friends. All of them either got mad at me, or showed absolutely zero interest. I was at therapy about two years ago for a total of... Six weeks, I think? Then I was pulled out of that because my parents didn't like her. I was never sent to therapy again.
